Leads and Contacts

A POST request for a new lead wil also create a new contact record, but only if a matching contact is not found. A matching contact is one that meets this criteria:

Has a first name identical to the request first_name

Has a last name identical tp the request last_name

Has an e-mail address or phone number field identical to those in the request

If owner_id is not in the request, the contact meets the above matching criteria and is owned by the same organization
